title: IAEA Live Chart: 4He is listed stable, abundance 99.9998
summary: The Live Chart ground-state row for 4He says STABLE and lists abundance 99.9998.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 4He (Z=2, N=2), extracted 2026-11-18, lists the half-life field as STABLE and the abundance field as 99.9998 with unc_a 0.0002. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 8-OCT-1991. Abundance here is the column in that row, not a new assay.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 4He
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides
sources.note: CSV row extracted 2026-11-18. ENSDF cut-off field: 8-OCT-1991.

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.
